<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@graph":[{"@type":"FAQPage","@id":"https://www.praxerasupplements.com/alp/ads-mfg-usa#faq","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Why does U.S. manufacturing matter for supplement brands?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Three reasons. Quality: U.S. manufacturers operate under FDA oversight with consistent enforcement. Supply chain: shorter lead times, lower freight costs, less disruption risk. Marketing: 'Made in USA' resonates with significant portions of supplement buyers and is verifiable in your marketing claims."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Are you actually FDA-registered?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. Our Vermont facility has been continuously FDA-registered since the agency began requiring registration. We are also GMP-certified to NSF GMP 455-2, the most rigorous supplement-specific GMP standard."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Is U.S. manufacturing more expensive than overseas?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Per-unit it can be, depending on the formulation. Total landed cost (after shipping, duties, quality risk, and turnaround time) often makes U.S. manufacturing cost-competitive or better. Most clients who price it out side-by-side end up choosing U.S. manufacturing for reasons beyond just unit cost."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I tour the facility?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. We host facility tours for prospective and active clients. Schedule through your account manager or the contact form."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What's the minimum order size to work with you?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Most stock formulations have MOQs in the low hundreds of bottles per SKU. Specific MOQs depend on the formulation. We provide exact numbers during your consultation."}}]}]}</script>
